{"notes": "VISIT 3 (left at 7:00). Nobody spoke while I was there, so I got no new evidence on any individual. Table: the fish looks complete and fully connected from the nose to both tail tips (top tip curls to about (27.5, 4.5), bottom to about (28, 15.5)). Doubled/tight dominoes at x=16.5-18 and x=20-21 are still there and may be fragile joins. The pale stray domino near (15, 6) is still unconnected and still unclaimed. I still don't know who placed which domino, so build credit stays shared.

Maya: No new observation. Earlier: set a clear hands-off tone and reassured the team, and her visit 1 handoff plan seems to have worked. Collaboration and leadership look strong but are based on what I heard, not on seeing her build. Ask her what she placed and how she ran the handoffs.

Tom: No new observation. Earlier: silent in visit 1, then spoke up in visit 2 and accurately reported the run as connected to both tips, which shows he was paying attention. Ask him what he built and whether the stray is his.

Priya: No new observation. Earlier: backed the hands-off plan and was considerate. The top arm is clean, but I can't confirm she placed it. Ask her.

Leo: Silent again. His visit 1 offer to take the far ends may explain the tail, but I didn't see it, so I can't credit him. Ask him what he placed, who joined the sections, and about the stray.

Provisional: team result is strong, though the fall is still untested. No one stands out or underperforms on my evidence. Individual ratings should rest on the review conversations, not guesses. Keep scores near the middle until I hear each person's account."}
